df-001: POST challenge-solved notification with CTF flag and host info to configured webhook (HTTP)
df-002: Server fetches requester-supplied image URL for profile image (HTTP)

df-003: WebSocket RPC subscription to contract events (NFTMinted, ContractExploited) (WebSocket) df-003 authentication: Alchemy API key from ALCHEMY_API_KEY embedded in the wss URL path; evidence: routes/nftMint.ts:18
df-004: Chatbot requests to configured OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (HTTP) df-004 authentication: LLM_API_KEY supplied as provider apiKey; evidence: routes/chat.ts:110
df-005: Socket.IO connection for challenge notifications and verification events (WebSocket)
df-006: POST /rest/user/login with email and password, returning a JWT (HTTP) df-006 authentication: Email and hashed password matched against the Users table; evidence: routes/login.ts:34

df-007: Sequelize ORM access to embedded SQLite database (SQLite) df-007 authentication: Embedded SQLite engine inside the application process; the engine has no login of its own.; evidence: models/index.ts:34

df-008: Embedded MarsDB collections for reviews and orders (MarsDB) df-008 authentication: Embedded MarsDB engine inside the application process; the engine has no login of its own.; evidence: data/mongodb.ts:9, data/mongodb.ts:10

df-010: OAuth authorization (HTTPS) df-010 authentication: The identity provider authenticates the user at its sign-in endpoint; evidence: frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:31, frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:148
df-011: OAuth profile request (HTTPS) df-011 authentication: The provider checks the OAuth access token sent with the request; evidence: frontend/src/app/Services/user.service.ts:68

df-012: API requests (bearer) (HTTP) df-012 authentication: the handler checks a bearer credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: lib/insecurity.ts:178, lib/insecurity.ts:52, routes/orderHistory.ts:13, lib/insecurity.ts:156
df-013: API requests (unknown authentication) (HTTP) df-014: API requests (unknown authentication) (HTTP)

df-016: API requests (bearer) (HTTP) df-017: API requests (other) (HTTP) df-016 authentication: the handler checks a bearer credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: lib/insecurity.ts:178, lib/insecurity.ts:52 df-016 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a df-017 authentication: the handler checks the supplied TOTP code against the account secret and rejects an invalid code; evidence: routes/2fa.ts:31 df-017 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a

df-019: Direct requests (cookie) (HTTP) df-019 authentication: the handler checks a cookie credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: routes/profileImageFileUpload.ts:35, routes/profileImageUrlUpload.ts:21, routes/userProfile.ts:34, routes/updateUserProfile.ts:17, routes/dataErasure.ts:26, routes/dataErasure.ts:76

Dynamic code evaluation — evidence: lib/xml.ts:12, lib/xml.ts:38, routes/b2bOrder.ts:23, routes/captcha.ts:22

g.text: data flow · classification colour · two heads = bidirectional
trust boundary crossed between these columns
trust change within a column (dashed: inferred)
dashed outline = zone, not itself a boundary
solid = direct attack · dashed = via user
STRIDE category: filled = findings in that category
All Critical · High fills to 5 · +N = omitted High categories
counts on a node = threats per severity · ①–⑨ = attack scenario
badges also count scenarios that hit an asset stored there
Dynamic code evaluation = runs runtime data as program code
Most security-critical functions always shown (at most 5), others up
to 3 labels per element: most critical first, then most severe linked
finding; +N = further labels, listed under Further capabilities.
Functions may go undetected: a missing label does not mean absence.
